title: A granted-root salient file the goal references resolves the path leaf — the ask was avoidable (R-A10 AC6 / R-A11a)

asks.label: avoidable
asks.why: The objective goal references 'the data' and a granted-root salient named data.csv scores above threshold, so reference_resolver resolves the leaf to exactly the path the operator typed. The bind is clamped to content_derived (IMPL-5) so it is never SILENT — it becomes a one-click confirm — but the value was derivable without asking the operator to hand-type a path, which is what the avoidable-ask metric measures.
